LightningComponentBundle.description: Pro-code payment form — a drop-in replacement for a payment Flow screen. Amount, currency and frequency are set by the admin; the payer enters their details and pays.

property.name: defaultCurrency
property.label: Default currency
property.description: ISO currency code shown next to the amount (e.g. EUR, USD, GBP). Used as the fixed default when no picker is enabled.

property.name: allowedCurrencies
property.label: Allowed currencies (CSV)
property.description: Comma-separated ISO codes (e.g. EUR,USD,GBP) to let the payer pick the currency. Leave empty to use the Default currency above.

property.name: currencySource
property.label: Default currency source
property.description: Currency selected on load: fixed (Default currency above), user (org/user currency), or page (?currency= URL parameter).

property.name: amount
property.label: Amount
property.description: Amount the payer is charged. Set by the admin; shown read-only to the payer.

property.name: defaultFrequency
property.label: Frequency
property.description: Payment frequency. Set by the admin; shown read-only to the payer.
